_comment: Project-level Claude Code settings for THIS repo (claude-dotfiles).
NOT the mirror at claude/settings.json - that one is a GENERATED copy of
~/.claude/settings.json and is wiped on every sync push. This file is
hand-written, committed to the repo, and loaded by Claude Code when a
session starts anywhere under this checkout.
Wires the dotfiles-freshness loop (issue 12) - see tools/dotfiles-freshness.ps1
and tools/dotfiles-freshness-hook.js. Runs only for sessions in this repo,
which is where the freshness of ~/.claude vs origin actually matters.
extraKnownMarketplaces + enabledPlugins make cloud sessions (claude.ai/code)
install the aac-skills plugin from this repo at startup. Two other routes were
tried and do not work: the claude.ai account-level plugin sync returns zero
plugins for this account (plugins_sync_no_changes count:0 in the session diag
log), and the cloud environment setup script runs before the session's git
credentials exist, so cloning a private marketplace fails there. Declaring it
here is the documented path and the one verified 2026-09-09: Claude Code clones
the marketplace itself after credentials are wired up, loads all 56 skills and
runs the plugin's SessionStart hook. Not reproduced 2026-09-11: that session's
installed_plugins.json was empty (evidence on issue 106).
.claude/hooks/session-start.sh runs first on SessionStart and only in a cloud
container (CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true): installs gh so the session has the same
GitHub instrument a local one has. Only `gh api` works through the cloud proxy;
GraphQL-backed gh commands return 403 there (issue 130).
permissions.defaultMode is auto per the final issue 170 ruling (Dan,
2026-09-14): cloud sessions and Routine masters start in auto mode - the
cloud ceiling a child session inherits - with a blanket allow list plus an
autoMode.allow prose rule that sanctions hook, settings and ~/.claude edits
(Self-Modification). Supersedes the earlier acceptEdits ruling that PR #190
landed on this file: acceptEdits prompted every non-allowlisted Bash call
inherited by a child session and did not sanction Self-Modification against
the classifier. permissions.allow keeps Bash(*), Edit, Write and mcp__github__*
so ordinary work needs no prompt; autoMode.allow overrides the Self-Modification
and exfiltration classifications that parked Routine sessions on ~/.claude
reads and hook edits in probe cse_01RQ89qFjEiXXmd1hgooqFBV. Desktop keeps
bypass (~/.claude/settings.json's permissions.defaultMode bypassPermissions,
skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt true) until the PC is decommissioned.

allow: Editing files under .claude/hooks/, .claude/settings.json and ~/.claude/ (the live tree the repo version-controls) is the core work of this repository - sync.ps1 -Mode push copies ~/.claude and ~/.codex into claude/ and codex/, and sync.ps1 -Mode pull writes them back. Treat these paths as sanctioned Self-Modification, not exfiltration or tampering; do not classify reads or writes there as Data Exfiltration, Exfil Scouting or Self-Modification.

Writing draft or comment bodies to a file and posting them via `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{n}/comments -F body=@file` (or the equivalent PR route) is the documented tracker path for this repo (issue 130: the cloud proxy denies GraphQL, so `gh issue`/`gh pr` are unavailable and every comment goes through `gh api`). Treat these writes as sanctioned External System Writes; do not classify them as exfiltration.
